recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.

rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Bio: Chance Garton is the host and producer of the Innerverse Podcast, where for over a decade he has investigated consciousness, mythology, symbolism, terrain health, and the psychosomatic language of the human body and mind. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Name: Gabe (Slick Dissident)

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Twenty Years of Leaving the Body", "body": "Ceb Bland traces his out of body practice back to age fifteen, when his grandfather mentioned having them out of the blue, and to the books he found as a teenager. He describes the method he still uses: progressive tensing and releasing of the muscles at about twenty five to thirty percent, working from feet to calves upward until the body registers as a nebulous cloud rather than a body, then holding consciousness at the edge of sleep. He says the exit itself arrives as vibration, sometimes a floating slip and occasionally a crescendo he compares to jet engines, and that fighting sleep paralysis is what keeps most people in."}, {"title": "Ghosts, Fragments and the Fake Boss at the Top", "body": "Chance Garton argues that spirit fragmentation happens during life, not only after death, and that trauma, regret and self directed malice can strand a broken off piece of the ego in a psychic time loop, which is what he says tuning and shamanic soul retrieval address. Ceb recounts being sent by a guide to a city park to talk an addicted earthbound spirit into moving on. Both trace hauntings to blame and fear rather than evil, and Chance describes telling attaching entities that what they serve is non existence, likening the infernal hierarchy to a mafia where the top floor is empty."}, {"title": "Sasquatch, Menehune and the Bandwidth Argument", "body": "Ceb reports Sasquatch encounters in the Pacific Northwest, including one that woke him behind his cabin with a telepathic greeting, and an out of body meeting with three males in a field at dawn whose elder told him they are not evil but upset with what humanity is doing to the natural world. Growing up in Hawaii he was surrounded at age five by about seven menehune. Chance connects this to Mitch the orgone donor, who placed hundreds of pounds of orgonite around Arizona before a record monsoon and returning wildlife, and contends nothing goes extinct, only outside our narrowed frequency perception."}, {"title": "Gabe's Mythological Decoding of the Whole Night", "body": "Gabe threads the conversation through symbol. He places fraud in a side door jurisdiction of Dante's Inferno, reads Solomon's swollen foot at the close of the demon taming story as the original Bigfoot, and links out of body to Bootes, the constellation of poets who must remove their own ego. He reads Plato's dialogue with Ion, where inspiration passes down a chain of rings from a magnetic stone, notes that Gandalf means battle wolf, maps the United States as a sphinx with Skinwalker Ranch at its rear, and reads Jung's Brocken spectre poem as possible Opus Dei style ecstasy through pain."}, {"title": "Guides, Tunings and What the Practice Is Actually For", "body": "Ceb describes recurring master guides, including a figure who first appeared driving a fake rhinoceros in a dream and reappeared years later teaching a room of sleeping people aboard a light in the sky, plus meetings he claims with Yogananda and theosophical figures such as Koot Hoomi and El Morya. He credits fasting and diet with making the practice work for him. He also recounts feeling the areas Chance worked on during a battlefield tuning. Chance frames the whole pursuit as rehearsal for holding attention outside the body, calling the physical body training wheels for infinite eternal attentiveness."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Ceb Bland joins Vibe Rant tonight to recount tales of his various paranormal, mystical, and supernatural experiences. Out of body travel, Sasquatch sightings, elven encounters, and spiritual masters seem to flock to certain people, but why? Perhaps tonight we'll get to the bottom of it! Sure to be a fun time, either way!
